instructions.question: Does this Albanian Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express a clear positive or negative stance, or is it neutral?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default and the most common label. It covers worry or sadness about the numbers, scolding citizens for not wearing masks, advice and appeals, questions or demands for data, speculation about the true numbers, jokes, banter about towns 'leading' or cheering the numbers ('hajde ma gjall'), tags and condolences. Negative needs open hostility aimed at the institute, government or authorities: calling them liars, insults, curses, mockery of them, or angry 'enough of you' complaints. Positive needs explicit thanks, praise, blessings or good wishes, or relief that cases are falling or the virus is gone.

neutral.what: Comments with no clear stance toward the institute or authorities: worry, observations, calculations, questions, requests for more data, advice to citizens, jokes, teasing friends, cheering or betting on numbers, and condolences.
examples: Sa keq, numri kaq i larte (How bad, the number is so high)
Pse ka Mitrovica Verit nuk po jepni Rezultate hiq !? (Why aren't you giving any results for North Mitrovica!?)
Koka qu sot heret ai i laboratorit (The lab guy got up early today)
Maqedonia afër kolapsimit është , ju lutem mos dilni kot (Macedonia is near collapse, please don't go out for nothing)
neutral.cues: hahaha, tagged names, hajde ma gjall (come on, livelier), pse (why), a ka (is there), duhet (should), mos dilni (don't go out), maska (masks), sa keq (how bad), ngushllime (condolences)
neutral.not_for: Questions that call the institute liars or insult it are negative.

positive.what: Explicit thanks, praise of the institute or doctors, blessings, recovery wishes, or relief and joy that the virus is fading.
examples: Bravooo, pune te mbar! (Bravo, good work!)
Mashallah kofshin me ymer (God bless, may they live long)
Ska mo virus (There's no more virus)
Perhajr edhe Juve (Blessings to you too)
positive.cues: bravo, ju lumtë (well done), faleminderit (thank you), sherim te shpejte (quick recovery), mashallah, perhajr (congratulations/blessings), ishalla po pshtoni (God willing you'll be saved)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise is negative. Cheering numbers like 'hajde ma gjall' (come on, livelier), town pride, condolences, and appeals to wear masks are neutral.

negative.what: Hostility toward the institute, government or authorities: claims of lies or fake numbers, insults, curses, mockery, and fed-up anger at them.
examples: ooooo qfar rrene (what lies)
Boll bre mo se na lodhet (Enough already, you've worn us out)
Haahhaha shum bosa jeni na tranut (Hahaha, you're so empty, you've driven us mad)
Qeveria ne gjum (The government is asleep)
negative.cues: rren / rrene (lie), mashtrim (fraud), propagand, bosa (empty-headed), na lodhet (you've tired us), Zoti i vraft (may God kill them), qeveria (the government) + blame
negative.not_for: Worry, sadness, scolding fellow citizens, doubts about testing coverage, and demands for data are neutral.
